question: For the CURRENT task in the state, is the {name} {axis} facet required in addition to the baseline? Judge from its goal, acceptance (done), changed paths and diff. A plan for future work does not implement that work now.
flow: For the CURRENT task in the state, is registered flow {name} required in addition to the selected flows? Judge from its goal, acceptance (done), changed paths and diff.
defer: Insufficient information to select one option reliably.

criteria:refactor: The task's acceptance claims behavior-preserving restructuring: a refactor, move, rename or cleanup that must not change observable behavior, contracts, errors or side effects.
The task adds features, fixes a defect, changes intended behavior, or only writes plans or prose; it makes no behavior-preservation claim.
criteria:documentation: The task changes or adds ordinary prose documentation (README, guides, docs pages, design notes, research or decision records) whose facts, examples or links must be checked against their sources.

No ordinary prose documentation is changed. Plan and roadmap documents (docs/plans, phase plans, overview status rows), code, tests, data, configuration and executable prompts are not ordinary prose documentation.
criteria:security: The change touches authentication, authorization, credentials or secrets, permissions, sandboxing, or untrusted input crossing a trust boundary: parsing externally supplied files or data, loading third-party code or model weights, or sending user-derived input to an external service.
The change touches none of authentication, authorization, secrets, permissions, sandboxing, external input parsing, third-party code loading or outbound use of user input.
criteria:data: The change alters persisted data: a stored schema, file format or record fields (state files, ledgers, run records, databases), a migration, or writes or deletions that could lose or corrupt existing data.
No stored schema, record field, file format, migration, persisted write or deletion is changed.
criteria:async: The change touches concurrency or lifetime: background jobs, threads, async tasks, locks, retries, cancellation, timeouts, restarts or resources that must be released.
The change involves no concurrency, background work, retries, cancellation, timeouts or resource lifetime.
criteria:performance: The task's acceptance claims a speed, latency, memory or cost improvement, or sets a performance budget.
The task makes no performance claim and sets no performance budget; correctness is the goal.
evidence:offline: The task has local tests, contracts, document or scenario checks that must pass on the current head.
The task is exempt from every local check.
evidence:api: Acceptance depends on a running service, process or external provider: deployed endpoints, real provider or model calls, a smoke check of a running service, or authentication or persistence that local tests and fixtures cannot prove.
Local tests, fixtures or static checks prove the whole acceptance; no running service, process or external provider call is part of it.
evidence:browser: Acceptance concerns a web UI a person uses in a browser now: rendering, layout, navigation, focus, keyboard or a browser user flow.
No current browser UI behavior is part of acceptance: backend, API, CLI, data, prose, or a plan for future UI.
evidence:desktop: Acceptance concerns a native desktop or mobile app, packaged host, OS process, CLI host hook or notification behavior now.
No native desktop, mobile, packaged-app, OS process or host hook behavior is part of current acceptance.
evidence:differential: The task claims behavior preservation (a refactor or test cleanup), so frozen before/after characterization checks must match on this head.

The task intentionally changes behavior, content, data or models, adds features, or only writes plans or prose. Keeping some invariants or hashes while intentionally changing content is not a preservation claim.

flows: Current acceptance depends on what registered flow {flow} (in state.registered_flows) verifies.
The change does not affect what registered flow {flow} (in state.registered_flows) verifies.
